svg.title: Move execution and time separately
svg.desc: A control panel of five simulator commands, not a required sequence. The simulator uses a pinned artifact, input, explicit Action mocks, and a timezone-aware starting clock, and never calls a provider. 1. Inspect without advancing: inspect() reads the current view and set_breakpoints() marks where Continue should pause (Studio: Breakpoints, then check the steps; CLI: breakpoints). 2. Take one execution step: next() processes one admitted event or one IR node, including start, end, branch-output, and join nodes (Studio: Step; CLI: next). 3. Continue to a stopping point: continue_until_breakpoint() runs until a breakpoint, wait, suspension, termination, or the command work ceiling (Studio: Continue; CLI: continue). 4. Queue a signal or a human decision: signal(name, payload) and human_decision(node_id, payload) validate the payload and queue it at virtual now; use Step or Continue to let the graph consume it (Studio: Send, Submit decision; CLI: signal, human_decision). 5. Move virtual time: advance_time(seconds) changes virtual now only; use Step or Continue to process newly due timers (Studio: under Advance time, a preset, or an Amount and Advance; CLI: advance_time). Virtual time governs timers; server debug sessions expire after one real hour, and saving progress or virtual time does not extend that lifetime.
svg.text: Move execution and time separately
The simulator uses a pinned artifact, input, explicit mocks, and a
timezone-aware starting clock.
READ AS A CONTROL PANEL • Choose the command for the change you want
1. Inspect without advancing
inspect() reads the current view.
set_breakpoints() marks where Continue should pause.
Studio: Breakpoints, then check the steps • CLI: breakpoints
OBSERVE • No provider calls are made
2. Take one execution step
next() processes one admitted event OR one IR node.
Start, end, branch-output, and join nodes also count.
Studio: Step • CLI: next
STEP • One boundary is not necessarily one visible Action
3. Continue to a stopping point
continue_until_breakpoint() runs until a breakpoint, wait,
suspension, termination, or command work ceiling.
Studio: Continue • CLI: continue
CONTINUE • Work remains bounded
4. Queue a signal or a human decision
signal(name, payload) and human_decision(node_id, payload)
validate the payload and queue it at virtual now.
Studio: Send (signal name), Submit decision • CLI: signal, human_decision
QUEUE • Then step or continue to let the graph consume it
5. Move virtual time, then process due work
advance_time(seconds) changes virtual now only.
Then step or continue to process newly due timers.
Studio: Advance time (a preset, or Amount and Advance) • CLI: advance_time
TIME • Advancing the clock does not reduce the graph
Two clocks have different jobs
Virtual time governs timers. Server debug sessions expire after one real
hour; saving progress and virtual time does not extend that lifetime.

g.text: Move virtual time explicitly; simulations never call live providers.
